title: status_report Module
content_markdown:
The Status/Report module is a wrapper over the internal status/report framework, allowing the script writer to dynamically define and use of SR groups.

By bringing the Status/Report support into the script, it opens the possibility to create custom reports from script, depending on the logic you have there.
overview:
The Status/Report module is a wrapper over the internal status/report framework, allowing the script writer to dynamically define and use of SR groups.

By bringing the Status/Report support into the script, it opens the possibility to create custom reports from script, depending on the logic you have there.

exported_parameters.name: script_sr_group
exported_parameters.description:
Name of a new Status/Report group to be created and later used from script level.

This parameter may be defined multiple times, in order to define multiple groups.

exported_functions.name: sr_set_status

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: the name of the SR group; you can change the status only for the groups defined via this module (as parameter).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: the new status value ( strict positive meaning OK, strict negative meaning NOT OK, 0 is not accepts, it is converted to 1 automatically).

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: a descripting text to detail the status value

exported_functions.description: Sets a new status (and details) for a Status/Report group.

exported_functions.name: sr_add_report

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: the name of the SR group; you can change the status only for the groups defined via this module (as parameter).

exported_functions.description: Adds a new report/log to a Status/Report group.This must have been defined via this module too.
